resident_confirmed_record_fields.0: signed X delta applied when advancing records
resident_confirmed_record_fields.1: signed Y delta applied when advancing records
resident_confirmed_record_fields.3: signed minimum Y bound relative to object anchor
resident_confirmed_record_fields.4: signed maximum Y bound relative to object anchor
resident_confirmed_record_fields.5: signed minimum X bound relative to object anchor
resident_confirmed_record_fields.6: signed maximum X bound relative to object anchor
resident_confirmed_record_fields.7: reserved/zero in every catalogued primary record
resident_confirmed_record_fields.8..9: optional 32-bit transition token; 0xffffffff in every catalogued primary record
